role: Value type for strap-memory download progress (stage, 0–1 progress, attempt/maxAttempts, English status message) shown by the record screen; aliased as PolarManager.FetchProgress (PolarManager.swift:336).
types: StrapFetchProgress.Stage: enum String — stopping/finalizing/listingExercises/fetchingData/reconnecting/retrying/complete/failed with English log text raw values
toplevel: Type declarations only; no stored constants.

flags.text: statusMessage is set by every StrapFetchProgress construction but never read (only DeviceRecoveryView reads stage/progress/attempt/maxAttempts). (The unused `idle` constant was removed by b10.)

Stages .listingExercises, .retrying and .failed are never assigned by production code (every updateProgress call in StrapRecordingCoordinator+Transfer.swift uses .complete/.stopping/.finalizing/.reconnecting/.fetchingData), so DeviceRecoveryView's 'Data is safe on <device>' row for .retrying/.failed never shows.
